text:
Good afternoon departures team,

The front-counter lead sent an update on cooling checks. The recent review looks steady overall, and I want to thank everyone for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk calm and careful during the busy rush. The handoff notes are clear, the cooling indicators have been easy to track, and the usual follow-through has been solid. <<FACT F102>> Please keep using the same steady approach when a pet crate needs extra attention, and make sure any unusual reading is passed along right away so we can sort it out without fuss.

A few small reminders will help us keep things smooth for travelers and pets alike. Please keep speaking in a low, reassuring way at the counter, and keep the travel guidance short, kind, and practical. If a crate arrives with signs of stress, moisture, or poor airflow, pause, check the setup, and follow the usual review steps. It is better to slow down for a moment than to let a concern drift. The goal is not perfection, just consistent care and early notice when something looks off. That makes the whole process safer for the animal and less stressful for the customer.

If you notice any repeated pattern, flag it through the normal channel so the review can stay simple and fair. We do not need to make a big scene out of routine corrections; we just need to keep the checks honest and the communication clear. Thanks again for the attention you bring to these details. It makes a real difference for the animals in our care and for the passengers who trust Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
